info.name: Delta Homes API
info.description:
Backend REST API for the Delta Homes marketplace (Spring Boot + PostgreSQL).

Base URL is controlled by the collection variable `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080).

The `token` and `refreshToken` collection variables are set automatically after a successful **Login** or **Login with OTP** request, so authenticated requests can use `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

To register a new account:
1. POST /auth/otp/send with purpose REGISTRATION
2. Read the OTP from the server console (dev mode) or the SMS.
3. POST /auth/register with the code in `otpCode`.

## List (index) endpoints

Every list endpoint returns a uniform paginated envelope:

```json
{
  "content": [ ... ],
  "page": 0,
  "size": 20,
  "totalElements": 0,
  "totalPages": 0,
  "hasNext": false
}
```

All list endpoints support Spring Data paging via `page` (0-based), `size`, and `sort` (e.g. `sort=price,desc`). Sort properties are camelCase and are mapped to snake_case columns automatically.

Most also support PostgreSQL full-text search through the `q` parameter (matched against a generated `search_vector` column), e.g. `q=apartment` or `q="fully finished"`.

Filter query parameters are optional; pass any combination you need. All public list endpoints only return verified/published records.

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit SMS OTP. `purpose` is one of REGISTRATION | LOGIN | PASSWORD_RESET.
In dev mode (no Twilio credentials) the code is printed to the server console.
Verifies an OTP code without creating any account. Optional — the register/login endpoints verify the code themselves.

Registers a new account. Requires a verified REGISTRATION OTP. `role` is one of CUSTOMER | OWNER | OFFICE | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN (ADMIN is provisioned by the platform). Returns access + refresh tokens.
Logs in with phone + password. Stores the returned tokens in the `token` and `refreshToken` collection variables for subsequent requests.
Password-less login using a LOGIN-purpose OTP. The account must already exist. Also stores tokens into collection variables.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a fresh pair of access + refresh tokens.
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user (requires a valid access token).
Changes the password of the authenticated user. Requires the current password.
Resets a forgotten password. Requires a PASSWORD_RESET OTP sent to the account phone. No authentication needed.
Logs out. The API is stateless, so the client simply discards its tokens.
Paginated list of cities with optional full-text search on the city name (Arabic and English). Public.
Paginated list of districts. Optional `q` full-text search and optional `cityId` filter. Public.
Paginated list of services (finishing / maintenance categories). Optional `q` full-text search and optional `category` filter. Public.
Paginated list of property features with optional `q` full-text search. Public.
Paginated list of subscription plans. Optional `q` search, `tier` (BASIC | PREMIUM | ENTERPRISE) and `isActive` filters. Public.

Paginated property index with PostgreSQL full-text search (`q` against title + description) and filters: `cityId`, `districtId`, `purpose` (SALE | RENT), `minPrice`, `maxPrice`. Supports `sort` (e.g. `price,desc`, `createdAt,asc`) and paging. Only PUBLISHED properties are returned. Response is the standard PaginatedResponse envelope with a `content` array of property summaries.
Returns full details of a single property by UUID. Note: this endpoint currently returns the full entity (including nested relationships) — the list endpoint uses a safe summary projection.
Creates a property listing. Requires authentication (Owner / Office / Admin).

Paginated company index with full-text search (`q` against name, description, phone, email, website) and optional `type` filter (REAL_ESTATE_OFFICE | FINISHING_COMPANY | MAINTENANCE_PROVIDER). Supports `sort` and paging. Only VERIFIED companies are returned. Public.
Returns a company profile by UUID (finishing / maintenance provider). Public.
Follows/unfollows a company to receive its broadcasts. Requires authentication.

Paginated review index. Optional `q` full-text search on the review comment, `entityType` (PROPERTY | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | SERVICE_PROVIDER), `entityId` and `minRating` (1-5) filters. Supports `sort` (e.g. `rating,desc`) and paging. Public.
Creates a review on an entity (property / company / technician). Requires an accepted appointment (interaction_verified). Requires authentication.

Paginated list of the authenticated user's appointments, both as customer and as owner/company. Optional `status` filter (PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED). Requires authentication.
Books a property visit or service appointment. Requires authentication.
Updates an appointment status: PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED.
Paginated list of the authenticated user's conversations, newest first. Each entry includes the other participant's id/name and the last message preview. Requires authentication.
Paginated list of messages in a conversation, with optional `q` full-text search on the message text. Requires authentication (participants only).
Sends a message in a conversation. Text, image or a shared entity card (payload JSON). Requires authentication.
Universal smart search across properties, companies and services (Meilisearch/Typesense powered). Public.
Paginated list of the authenticated user's saved items for a given `entityType` (PROPERTY | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | SERVICE_PROVIDER). `entityType` is required. Requires authentication.
Saves an item (property / company / provider) for the authenticated user. Requires authentication.
Removes a saved item by entity type and entity id. Requires authentication.

Paginated broadcast index with full-text search (`q` against title + body) and optional `companyId` / `type` filters. `type` is one of NEW_PROPERTY | OFFER | DISCOUNT | VIDEO | NEWS. Requires authentication.
Creates a broadcast to followers. Requires an authenticated company user.

Paginated user index. Optional `q` full-text search (name / phone / email), `role` (CUSTOMER | OWNER | OFFICE | COMPANY | TECHNICIAN | ADMIN) and `status` (ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | PENDING | DELETED) filters. Safe summaries only — no credentials. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated moderation report index. Optional `q` search, `status` (OPEN | REVIEWING | RESOLVED | DISMISSED) and `entityType` filters. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated document/identity verification index. Optional `status` (PENDING | ACCEPTED | REJECTED) and `type` (PHONE | EMAIL | NATIONAL_ID | COMMERCIAL_REGISTRY) filters. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated fraud flag index. Optional `flagType` (DUPLICATE_LISTING | FAKE_REVIEW | SPAM_MESSAGE | ABNORMAL_FOLLOW_ACTIVITY) and `status` filters. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated coupon index with optional `q` full-text search on the coupon code. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated payment index. Optional `status` filter (PENDING | PAID | FAILED | REFUNDED). Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated audit log index. Optional `q` search (action / reason) and `adminId` filter. Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated subscription index. Optional `status` filter (ACTIVE | EXPIRED | CANCELLED). Requires ADMIN role.
Paginated broadcast index (admin view across all companies). Optional `q` search, `companyId` and `type` filters. Requires ADMIN role.
Accepts or rejects a document verification request (`decision`: ACCEPTED | REJECTED). Requires ADMIN role.
